name: Weftly API
description: AI post-production workflow for content creators. Transcribe and summarize audio and video, find compelling clips, cut horizontal clips or 9:16 vertical clips with burned-in captions, and cut a video from an edited transcript. No account required. Two payment rails: Stripe SPT (fiat card payments) and Tempo crypto (USDC via MPP).
